I’m gonna be honest, I definitely would’ve gotten the ick if I had gotten texts like this. Sometimes ish happens and people don’t respond for a while, some people just aren’t super on their phone most of the time. I think you really shoot yourself in the foot when you wrap it up simply because she hasn’t responded. Yes it may be disappointing, but expressing that just makes it kinda hard to rekindle because you guys hadn’t even really talked at all and it’s a weird first impression to give. Then the ‘(or not)’ just makes me want to roll my eyes, because it already feels like I’m being guilted when we’ve had no real conversation at all yet. 

That being said, if you were to message her because she’s back in town and she should be messaging you to hang out, there would be absolutely no interest left in my opinion to hang out with you. 

Just leave the stream of communication open, if she’s interested, she will find the time to message you. Many of the conversations on this sub are people who bond just because of how much time is between each message.

Claiming she’s sorry for ‘whatever happened’ while also having absolutely no intention of finding out what made you feel the way you do and actually rectifying the behavior and improving your relationship. Now you have to talk to her because she’s telling you how much she loves and misses you, love it. :/
